About AimeSimulator
Save and manage your NFC-F / FeliCa Lite cards, read data from physical cards, and emulate a selected card through Android HCE-F. Available features depend on the NFC hardware and system.
Features

• Manage multiple cards and read physical cards
• Emulate cards using their original IDm
• Import and export local card backups
• Optional LSPosed / KernelSU compatibility patches
• Dynamic colors and light/dark themes
Local by design

Profiles remain in the app’s private storage. Android backup is disabled, and the app requests no network permission and includes no telemetry, account, or cloud sync. Hiding an IDm or printed Access Code affects only its display.
Use and risk

Use only with cards and devices you own or are authorized to use. Selecting AimeSimulator as the default NFC app may interrupt payments through your usual wallet. Root, LSPosed, and KernelSU patches change how system NFC works; make sure you know how to disable them and restore normal NFC use.
About this project

AimeSimulator is an unofficial tool for card management and emulation on personal devices. Compatibility varies by device and reader. Aime, FeliCa, and related names and marks belong to their respective owners. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Default NFC app and wallet

Some Android systems require AimeSimulator to be the default contactless app before card emulation can run. Choosing it temporarily replaces your current wallet and may interrupt tap-to-pay. “Choose now” opens the system wallet settings; select AimeSimulator there. When you finish using it, choose “Restore wallet app” on the Status page and select your wallet again.
